## Considered — not applicable (31 agents)

The decisive litmus: **the surface briefing is appended at chat spawn**, so an agent running *in* a Chat session already has pin/progress knowledge automatically, and an agent dispatched via the Agent tool or `claude -p` does **not** — telling one of those to emit the fence would put raw JSON in front of the user. So for sub-agents, silence is the correct wiring, not an omission.

- **`sleep-tasks`** — owns `## Acceptance Criteria` and the `- [ ]` convention the progress route reads. No contract change needed: the convention it already maintains *is* the contract, and the route is read-only.
- **`sleep-state`, `sleep-product`, `sleep-migration`, `sleep-federation`, `sleep-learn`** — none creates, edits, retires or reads a pin, a shelf entry or a mode; a chat pin is session-scoped UI state that never enters the brain.
- **`curator-auditor/worker/verifier`** — audit knowledge/SSOT/features/tasks/versions/objectives. Pins are not curated brain artifacts.
- **`initializer-scout/ingestor/verifier`** — ingest source material into the hierarchy; no touchpoint.
- **`dreamcontext-explore`** — read-only searcher, returns text to its dispatcher.
- **`goal-plan-reviewer`, `goal-validator`, `reviewer`, `review-router/security/cloud-functions/frontend/edge-cases`** — read diffs and plans; adding fence knowledge would only risk emission into a non-Chat surface.
- **`council-persona`, `council-synthesizer`, `discover-brand`, `marketing-*` (3), `biv-*` (6)** — different domains entirely.
